Frequently asked questions

Which bookkeeping & admin tools work best for HVAC?

The three that fit best here are QuickBooks (Businesses that need proper books and an accountant who already knows the software), Dext (Businesses drowning in paper receipts for materials). Start with the one whose description matches your crew size, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does bookkeeping & admin software cost for HVAC?

Across the 2 tools on this page, 0 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices change often, so treat the figures here as indicative and confirm on the vendor site.

Why does bookkeeping & admin cause problems for HVAC specifically?

Warranty claims, service contracts and parts under warranty create three different money trails. Reconciling them monthly is the only way to know whether maintenance contracts actually pay.

Should maintenance contracts be billed monthly or annually?

Monthly billing is standard because it smooths seasonality and keeps the customer on the books. Annual billing is simpler to administer but leaves you without contact between visits.
